The actual security doesn't live in the conversion step itself. It lives entirely in how the financial network validates the instrument and how you structure the data in transit.

If the match flags, the transaction is declined before it ever touches your backend. If it clears, the network routes it to your acquiring bank, which then forwards it to the payment network. Risk engines don't just look at the numbers on the card. They look at the behavior.
